provenance: Public Algorithm 1 excerpt and saved review reason from the 2026-11-06 LOTUS run. The prose counterpart is cases.c8.quote in lotus_numeric_notation.json. No repaired answer or fresh model decision.
algorithm_quote:
𝜏+ ← max(𝜏+, 𝜏− )
𝑇 ′ ← ∅
// Evaluate predicate for each tuple
for 𝑡 ∈ 𝑇 do
if 𝐴(𝑡 ) ≥ 𝜏+ then
𝑇 ′ ← 𝑇 ′ ∪ { 𝑡 }
else if 𝐴(𝑡 ) ≥ 𝜏− then
if 𝑀 (𝑡 ) then
𝑇 ′ ← 𝑇 ′ ∪ { 𝑡 }
end
return 𝑇 ′
review_reason: The inclusive lower-threshold boundary is inconsistent in the source: prose rejects scores at or below it, while the algorithm routes equality to the oracle unless the thresholds coincide.
